definition.simple: A move against the trend that leaves the trend's structure intact.
definition.balanced: In an uptrend, a pullback falls but stays above the last higher low. At the time, a pullback and the start of a [[reversal]] look the same; only later candles show which it was.

example: Uptrend low 4,580, high 4,700. Price dips to 4,620, still above 4,580: a pullback so far.
